content.value_statement: Newsletter revenue plans often mix paid tiers, sponsorships, and referral loops without clear assumptions. This skill builds a labeled model, rate card, growth projection, and disclosure checklist.
actual_capabilities: Builds paid-subscription tier models with price points and conversion assumptions.
Creates sponsorship inventory and CPM, CPC, or flat-rate card options.
Projects revenue at list-growth milestones using stated growth-loop inputs.
Labels each number as measured, user-provided, estimated, or needing a source.
Flags sponsorship disclosure, unsubstantiated offer claims, and consent gaps for follow-up.
Produces a handoff summary for ROI calculation or email quality auditing.
limitations: Does not compute final SEND EQS scores or enforce auditor vetoes.
Does not own ROI, payback, or list-value calculations.
Requires user-provided list size, engagement metrics, price targets, or clear assumptions.
Does not connect to ESP, analytics, ecommerce, or ad APIs by itself.

use_cases.title: Launch a paid newsletter tier
use_cases.description: Turn audience size, engagement, and price ideas into a paid-tier revenue model with assumptions clearly labeled.

use_cases.title: Create sponsor packaging
use_cases.description: Define sellable placements, pricing basis, fill-rate assumptions, and disclosure checks before pitching sponsors.

use_cases.title: Compare hybrid revenue paths
use_cases.description: Compare paid subscriptions, sponsorships, and referral loops across current and future list-size milestones.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic monetization plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning from a small set of known metrics.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan monetization for my newsletter. I have [list size] subscribers, [open rate], [click rate], and I want [paid subscriptions, sponsorships, or both].

prompt_templates.title: Build a sponsorship rate card
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate sponsor packaging for an owned list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a sponsorship rate card for my newsletter using [active subscribers], [open rate], [click rate], [send cadence], and [available placements]. Label every assumption.

prompt_templates.title: Compare paid and hybrid models
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced revenue planning with multiple monetization paths.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare a paid-subscription-only model with a hybrid paid-subscription and sponsorship model for [list size], [price points], [conversion assumptions], and [fill rate].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare auditor-ready handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning before ROI calculation or SEND audit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an auditor-ready newsletter monetization handoff with measured inputs, estimated assumptions, D1 claim risks, S2 consent risks, and the recommended next skill.

output_examples.input: A 20,000-subscriber newsletter wants paid tiers and one sponsor slot per weekly issue.
output_examples.output: A revenue plan with paid-tier assumptions, weekly sponsor inventory, a CPM or flat-rate recommendation, disclosure checks, and open loops for missing data.

output_examples.input: A 45,000-subscriber list wants to compare paid-only and hybrid monetization.
output_examples.output: A side-by-side model showing expected revenue ranges, assumptions behind each line, list-growth milestones, and the next handoff for ROI math.

output_examples.input: A creator has a sponsor brief with performance claims and no claims ledger.
output_examples.output: A monetization checklist that marks the claim as unresolved, recommends offer-claims review, and avoids asserting unverified performance.

best_practices: Provide active subscribers, open rate, click rate, cadence, and the monetization goal before modeling.
Separate measured data from estimates so revenue projections are easy to audit.
Run claim, disclosure, and consent checks before using sponsor or paid-tier copy.
anti_patterns: Do not invent subscriber counts, CPMs, conversion rates, or prices to complete the model.
Do not present projected revenue as measured revenue when assumptions drive the result.
Do not sell sponsor inventory to audiences without confirmed commercial-mail consent.

faq.question: What does this skill help me plan?
faq.answer: It plans newsletter paid tiers, sponsorship inventory, referral loops, revenue projections, and disclosure checks.

faq.question: Does it calculate ROI?
faq.answer: No. It prepares monetization inputs and hands ROI, payback, and list-value math to the ROI calculator skill.

faq.question: Can it build a sponsor rate card?
faq.answer: Yes. It can define placements, CPM or flat pricing, fill-rate assumptions, and minimum sponsor terms.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide active subscribers, open rate, click rate, send cadence, current revenue, price ideas, and monetization goals.

faq.question: Does it connect to my email platform?
faq.answer: No. It works from user-provided exports or numbers and treats integrations as optional external conveniences.

faq.question: How does it handle legal or compliance issues?
faq.answer: It flags ad disclosure, claim substantiation, and consent risks for the proper registry or auditor workflow.
